text:
Tess: good morning team  bizarre WFH glitch: my Roomba pushed itself under the desk during my standup and apparently nudged the power strip so the modem lost power. instant panic. pic: /files/roomba_unplug.jpg :robot_face:
Marco: noooo the tiny domesticated saboteur. did the modem die or just reboot?
Tess: modem lights went dark for a solid minute then came back but the router never reestablished DHCP for my desktop. had to join via phone hotspot for the rest of the call.
Danielle: classic. quick check: unplug modem+router for 30s, bring up modem first, then router. also try `ping -c 4 8.8.8.8` to see if you have basic connectivity.
Omar: if router shows WAN but hosts have no IP, try renewing lease: `sudo dhclient -v` or `ip link set dev eth0 down && ip link set dev eth0 up`. sometimes the NIC needs a kick after a power blip.
Luis: also cable-management PSA: use adhesive cable clips or a cable raceway under the desk. Roombas will find anything that looks like a snack.
Tess: trying the `dhclient` trick now  desktop got a lease back. thanks Omar.
Marco: optional pro move: Velcro the strip to the back of the desk and use a short right-angle plug for the modem so it's harder to wiggle free.
Danielle: status-bot: quick reminder to folks  if you need reimb for cable clips or a small UPS for your router/modem, file it under "Home office equipment". keep receipts.
status-bot: Ticket created: HOME-2245 - "Roomba unplugged modem". If this becomes frequent, consider a small UPS for networking gear.
Tess: adopting a tiny UPS and cable clamps immediately. also considering a Roomba no-go magnetic strip under the desk. ordering clips now.
Omar: small tip: set your router to hand out a long DHCP lease so brief reboots don't kick people off meetings. also add static leases for key devices if you can.
Luis: pet-proofing for the win. also post the Roomba pic later  would love to see the culprit.
Tess: uploaded pic in thread  behold the tiny proud saboteur. :joy_cat: thanks for the help, will report back if the Roomba starts a mutiny.
Marco: solidarity. just bought a set of adhesive cable clips after a lamp almost ate my headphones last week.
Danielle: and if the UPS is on your expense, tag your manager. speedy recovery to networking. :thumbsup:
